metadata.description: yukineko's Claude Code tools. Hosts fde, a Forward Deployed Engineer harness (spec ratification gate + evidence ledger).

plugins.name: fde
plugins.description: Forward Deployed Engineer harness: resolves a target repo, keeps a ratified spec per target outside it, denies edits to unratified registered targets, and records a red/green evidence ledger. Partial scaffold: resolve, begin, ratify and status are implemented; gate, evidence and report currently answer undetermined (exit 2).
